mapper.sql: e.id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, e.category_id, category.category_code, category.category_name, e.model, e.specification, e.brand, e.manufacturer, e.factory_serial_number, e.production_date, e.commissioning_date, e.organization_id, organization.organization_code, organization.organization_name, e.location_id, location.location_code, location.location_name, e.primary_responsible_user_id, responsible.username AS primary_responsible_username, responsible.real_name AS primary_responsible_name, e.asset_number, e.lifecycle_stage, e.critical_flag, e.special_flag, e.oee_enabled, e.status, e.description, current_status.status_code AS current_status_code, current_status.status_since, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, current_status.status_since, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS status_duration_seconds, current_status.version AS current_status_version, barcode.id AS active_barcode_id, barcode.access_token AS active_barcode_token, e.created_time, e.updated_time, e.version

JOIN equipment_category category ON category.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND category.id = e.category_id AND category.deleted = 0 JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND organization.id = e.organization_id AND organization.deleted = 0 JOIN location ON location.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND location.id = e.location_id AND location.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_user responsible ON responsible.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND responsible.id = e.primary_responsible_user_id AND responsible.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status current_status ON current_status.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND current_status.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN equipment_barcode barcode ON barcode.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND barcode.equipment_id = e.id AND barcode.active_slot = 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment (tenant_id, equipment_code, equipment_name, category_id, model, specification, brand, manufacturer, factory_serial_number, production_date, commissioning_date, organization_id, location_id, primary_responsible_user_id, asset_number, lifecycle_stage, critical_flag, special_flag, oee_enabled, status, description, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{code}, #{request.equipmentName}, #{request.categoryId}, #{request.model}, #{request.specification}, #{request.brand}, #{request.manufacturer}, #{request.factorySerialNumber}, #{request.productionDate}, #{request.commissioningDate}, #{request.organizationId}, #{request.locationId}, #{request.primaryResponsibleUserId}, #{request.assetNumber}, #{request.lifecycleStage}, CASE WHEN #{request.critical} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{request.special} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{request.oeeEnabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{request.enabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{request.description}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM equipment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND equipment_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE equipment SET equipment_name = #{request.equipmentName}, category_id = #{request.categoryId}, model = #{request.model}, specification = #{request.specification}, brand = #{request.brand}, manufacturer = #{request.manufacturer}, factory_serial_number = #{request.factorySerialNumber}, production_date = #{request.productionDate}, commissioning_date = #{request.commissioningDate}, organization_id = #{request.organizationId}, location_id = #{request.locationId}, primary_responsible_user_id = #{request.primaryResponsibleUserId}, asset_number = #{request.assetNumber}, lifecycle_stage = #{request.lifecycleStage}, critical_flag = CASE WHEN #{request.critical} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, special_flag = CASE WHEN #{request.special} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, oee_enabled = CASE WHEN #{request.oeeEnabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, status = CASE WHEN #{request.enabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, description = #{request.description}, updated_by = #{operatorId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{request.version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_status_history WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND equipment_id = #{id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM equipment_transfer_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND equipment_id = #{id})

WITH RECURSIVE category_path AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, 0 AS distance FROM equipment_category WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{categoryId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_id, child.distance + 1 FROM equipment_category parent JOIN category_path child ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent.deleted = 0 ), ranked AS ( SELECT definition.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY definition.attribute_code ORDER BY path.distance ) AS row_number_value FROM category_path path JOIN equipment_attribute_definition definition ON definition.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND definition.category_id = path.id AND definition.status = 1 AND definition.deleted = 0 ) SELECT definition.id AS definition_id, definition.attribute_code, definition.attribute_name, definition.data_type, definition.unit, definition.required_flag, COALESCE( value.string_value, CAST(value.integer_value AS CHAR), CAST(value.decimal_value AS CHAR), CASE WHEN value.boolean_value = 1 THEN 'true' WHEN value.boolean_value = 0 THEN 'false' END, DATE_FORMAT(value.date_value, '%Y-%m-%d'), definition.default_value ) AS value FROM ranked definition LEFT JOIN equipment_attribute_value value ON value.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND value.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND value.attribute_definition_id = definition.id AND value.deleted = 0 WHERE definition.row_number_value = 1 ORDER BY definition.sort_order, definition.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM equipment_attribute_value WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND equipment_id = #{equipmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_attribute_value (tenant_id, equipment_id, attribute_definition_id, string_value, integer_value, decimal_value, boolean_value, date_value, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{equipmentId}, #{definitionId}, CASE WHEN #{dataType} IN ('STRING', 'ENUM') THEN #{value} END, CASE WHEN #{dataType} = 'INTEGER' THEN CAST(#{value} AS SIGNED) END, CASE WHEN #{dataType} = 'DECIMAL' THEN CAST(#{value} AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) END, CASE WHEN #{dataType} = 'BOOLEAN' THEN CASE WHEN LOWER(#{value}) = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END, CASE WHEN #{dataType} = 'DATE' THEN STR_TO_DATE(#{value}, '%Y-%m-%d') END, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT relation.id, relation.user_id, user.username, user.real_name, relation.responsibility_type, relation.start_date, relation.end_date, relation.status FROM equipment_responsible_person relation JOIN system_user user ON user.tenant_id = relation.tenant_id AND user.id = relation.user_id AND user.deleted = 0 WHERE relation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND relation.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND relation.deleted = 0 ORDER BY relation.responsibility_type, relation.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM equipment_responsible_person WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND equipment_id = #{equipmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_responsible_person (tenant_id, equipment_id, user_id, responsibility_type, start_date, end_date, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{equipmentId}, #{request.userId}, #{request.responsibilityType}, #{request.startDate}, #{request.endDate}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})
INSERT INTO equipment_current_status (tenant_id, equipment_id, status_code, status_since, source_type, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{equipmentId}, #{statusCode}, #{now}, 'SYSTEM', #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, status_code, status_since, reason, source_type, version FROM equipment_current_status WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND equipment_id = #{equipmentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_status_history (tenant_id, equipment_id, from_status_code, to_status_code, started_time, reason, source_type, changed_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{equipmentId}, #{fromStatusCode}, #{toStatusCode}, #{startedTime}, #{reason}, #{sourceType}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT history.id, history.from_status_code, history.to_status_code, history.started_time, history.ended_time, history.duration_seconds, history.reason, history.source_type, user.real_name AS changed_by_name FROM equipment_status_history history LEFT JOIN system_user user ON user.tenant_id = history.tenant_id AND user.id = history.changed_by AND user.deleted = 0 WHERE history.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND history.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY history.started_time DESC, history.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_dictionary_item item JOIN system_dictionary_type type ON type.tenant_id = item.tenant_id AND type.id = item.dict_type_id AND type.dict_code = 'equipment_status' AND type.status = 1 AND type.deleted = 0 WHERE item.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND item.item_value = #{statusCode} AND item.status = 1 AND item.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_transfer_record (tenant_id, equipment_id, from_organization_id, to_organization_id, from_location_id, to_location_id, from_responsible_user_id, to_responsible_user_id, transfer_reason, transferred_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{equipment.id}, #{equipment.organizationId}, #{request.organizationId}, #{equipment.locationId}, #{request.locationId}, #{equipment.primaryResponsibleUserId}, #{request.primaryResponsibleUserId}, #{request.reason}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT transfer.id, transfer.from_organization_id, from_organization.organization_name AS from_organization_name, transfer.to_organization_id, to_organization.organization_name AS to_organization_name, transfer.from_location_id, from_location.location_name AS from_location_name, transfer.to_location_id, to_location.location_name AS to_location_name, transfer.from_responsible_user_id, from_user.real_name AS from_responsible_name, transfer.to_responsible_user_id, to_user.real_name AS to_responsible_name, transfer.transfer_reason, operator.real_name AS transferred_by_name, transfer.transferred_time FROM equipment_transfer_record transfer LEFT JOIN organization from_organization ON from_organization.tenant_id = transfer.tenant_id AND from_organization.id = transfer.from_organization_id JOIN organization to_organization ON to_organization.tenant_id = transfer.tenant_id AND to_organization.id = transfer.to_organization_id LEFT JOIN location from_location ON from_location.tenant_id = transfer.tenant_id AND from_location.id = transfer.from_location_id JOIN location to_location ON to_location.tenant_id = transfer.tenant_id AND to_location.id = transfer.to_location_id LEFT JOIN system_user from_user ON from_user.tenant_id = transfer.tenant_id AND from_user.id = transfer.from_responsible_user_id LEFT JOIN system_user to_user ON to_user.tenant_id = transfer.tenant_id AND to_user.id = transfer.to_responsible_user_id LEFT JOIN system_user operator ON operator.tenant_id = transfer.tenant_id AND operator.id = transfer.transferred_by WHERE transfer.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND transfer.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY transfer.transferred_time DESC, transfer.id DESC

SELECT barcode.id, barcode.equipment_id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, barcode.access_token, barcode.barcode_type, CASE WHEN barcode.active_slot = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, barcode.generated_time, barcode.invalidated_time, barcode.invalidation_reason FROM equipment_barcode barcode JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = barcode.tenant_id AND e.id = barcode.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE barcode.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND AND barcode.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND barcode.active_slot = 1 ORDER BY barcode.generated_time DESC, barcode.id DESC

SELECT e.id FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN equipment_barcode barcode ON barcode.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND barcode.equipment_id = e.id AND barcode.active_slot = 1 WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.status = 1 AND e.deleted = 0 AND barcode.id IS NULL AND ORDER BY e.id

SELECT barcode.id, barcode.equipment_id, equipment.equipment_code, equipment.equipment_name, barcode.access_token, barcode.barcode_type, CASE WHEN barcode.active_slot = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, barcode.generated_time, barcode.invalidated_time, barcode.invalidation_reason FROM equipment_barcode barcode JOIN equipment ON equipment.tenant_id = barcode.tenant_id AND equipment.id = barcode.equipment_id AND equipment.deleted = 0 WHERE barcode.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND barcode.id = #{barcodeId} LIMIT 1

SELECT barcode.id, barcode.equipment_id, equipment.equipment_code, equipment.equipment_name, barcode.access_token, barcode.barcode_type, TRUE AS active, barcode.generated_time, barcode.invalidated_time, barcode.invalidation_reason FROM equipment_barcode barcode JOIN equipment ON equipment.tenant_id = barcode.tenant_id AND equipment.id = barcode.equipment_id AND equipment.deleted = 0 WHERE barcode.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND barcode.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND barcode.active_slot = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_barcode (tenant_id, equipment_id, access_token, barcode_type, active_slot, generated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{equipmentId}, #{accessToken}, #{barcodeType}, 1, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT barcode.access_token, equipment.equipment_code, equipment.equipment_name, category.category_name, location.location_name, current_status.status_code AS current_status_code, current_status.status_since FROM equipment_barcode barcode JOIN equipment ON equipment.tenant_id = barcode.tenant_id AND equipment.id = barcode.equipment_id AND equipment.deleted = 0 AND equipment.status = 1 JOIN equipment_category category ON category.tenant_id = equipment.tenant_id AND category.id = equipment.category_id AND category.deleted = 0 JOIN location ON location.tenant_id = equipment.tenant_id AND location.id = equipment.location_id AND location.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status current_status ON current_status.tenant_id = equipment.tenant_id AND current_status.equipment_id = equipment.id WHERE barcode.access_token = #{accessToken} AND barcode.active_slot = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT attachment.id AS attachment_id, attachment.original_name, attachment.content_type, relation.relation_type, relation.remark, relation.created_time FROM system_attachment_relation relation JOIN system_attachment attachment ON attachment.tenant_id = relation.tenant_id AND attachment.id = relation.attachment_id AND attachment.deleted = 0 WHERE relation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND relation.business_type = 'EQUIPMENT' AND relation.business_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY relation.sort_order, relation.id
SELECT id, category_name AS name, status FROM equipment_category WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND category_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, organization_name AS name, status FROM organization WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND organization_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, location_name AS name, organization_id, status FROM location WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND location_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, real_name AS name, organization_id, status FROM system_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND username = #{username} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
